CALENDAR_HELP_DIALOG_CONTENT_1: Here are your symptom overviews. These charts aren't filled by the symptoms you've added to your days, but by your overall symptom overviews. These symptom overviews can be filled in by tapping on the small green circle on the right of each day in your timeline.
CALENDAR_HELP_DIALOG_CONTENT_2: The color represents the intensity level.
TUTORIAL_SLIDE_1_TEXT: This section will allow you to learn more about how the application works so that you can easily become familiar with.
TUTORIAL_CREATE_SYMPTOM_TEXT: Everything starts with the symptoms you want to track. Open the Manage menu grid_view at the top, then Symptoms, and tap Add a new symptom. Create as many as you need: headache, stomach ache, fatigue…
TUTORIAL_TARGET_SYMPTOM_TEXT: Tap the symptom chip at the top and pick the one to track from the list. It is the one shown by the colored dot of each day and by the calendar. You can switch at any time.
TUTORIAL_DAY_OVERVIEW_TEXT: On each day, the colored dot sums up the intensity of the tracked symptom. Tap it, set the intensity and confirm: its color goes from green (no discomfort) to red. It can also be calculated automatically from your entries (Settings > Symptoms).
TUTORIAL_DAY_OVERVIEW_TEXT_CLASSIC: On each day, the big colored circle, on the right, sums up the intensity of the tracked symptom. Tap it, set the intensity and confirm: its color goes from green (no discomfort) to red. It can also be calculated automatically from your entries (Settings > Symptoms).
TUTORIAL_CALENDAR_TEXT: The calendar icon calendar_month shows the month colored by the intensity of each day. Tap a day to see its details. Further down, statistics sum up the month for each symptom and for your sleep.
TUTORIAL_ADD_EVENT_TEXT: The playlist_add button of a day adds an event at a precise time: a symptom and its intensity, a meal, a medication and its dose, a sport, a note or one of your own types. For wake-up and bedtime, simply tap their line.
TUTORIAL_ADD_EVENT_TEXT_CLASSIC: The playlist_add button in the header of a day adds an event at a precise time: a symptom and its intensity, a meal, a medication and its dose, a note, a sport or one of your own types. For wake-up and bedtime, tap the top and bottom right corners of the day.
TUTORIAL_EDIT_EVENT_TEXT: Tap an event to open it. Update reopens its form; Delete removes it, after confirmation.
TUTORIAL_MANAGE_TEXT: The Manage menu grid_view gathers your symptoms, meals, medications, sports and notes. For each meal, medication, sport or note, you can see its statistics and history, rename it (all its entries are updated) or delete it along with all its entries. The + tile creates your own event types (water, coffee, mood…), with their icon and color: up to 10 types in all.
TUTORIAL_MANAGE_TEXT_CLASSIC: The Manage menu grid_view gathers your symptoms, meals, medications, sports and notes. For each meal, medication, sport or note, you can see its history, rename it (all its entries are updated) or delete it along with all its entries. The + tile creates your own event types (water, coffee, mood…), with their icon and color: up to 10 types in all.
TUTORIAL_SETTINGS_TEXT: The gear settings opens the settings: language, time format, Appearance (dark mode, colors, interface version, calendar), backup reminders and above all Import / Export, so you never lose your data.
TUTORIAL_BACKUP_WHY_TEXT: Your data is stored only on your phone: no cloud, it belongs to you alone. The downside: if you lose or reset your phone, it is gone… unless you have a backup. Android does not let an app save a file without your action, so backing up is up to you, regularly. A weekly or daily reminder can help (Settings > Customization).
TUTORIAL_BACKUP_SAVE_TEXT:
In Settings > Import / Export:
• Save backup opens the Android save window: pick a folder (Downloads, Drive…) and confirm.
• Share backup sends the file by email, messaging or to the cloud of your choice.
The file name contains the date and time of the backup. Always keep a copy somewhere other than your phone.
TUTORIAL_BACKUP_RESTORE_TEXT:
Import lets you pick a backup file (.json), then asks for confirmation. Warning: importing replaces all current data with the content of the file.
To switch phones: save or share the file from the old one, get it on the new one, then import it.
TUTORIAL_PDF_REPORT_TITLE: A PDF report for your doctor
TUTORIAL_PDF_REPORT_TEXT: Export as PDF creates the report of a month: calendar and statistics of each symptom, sleep, most frequent medications, notes and sports. Pick the month and year, then share share or save save_alt the PDF. Only the symptoms filled in that month are included.

START_CONTENT_1: Welcome to the Life Notes app! Life Notes is an app that allows you to record your chronic symptoms and lifestyle habits on a daily basis in order to monitor them, but also to potentially highlight some correlations.
START_CONTENT_2: It's a non profit project on which I work alone on my free time outside of my job. I simply created this app to help as many people as possible who suffer from chronic symptoms like me.
START_CONTENT_3: This app is free, without ad, and without data collection, forever. It's just for you.
START_CONTENT_4: Working alone on this project, updates take time, but the app is constantly evolving. I'm aware of the missing features, and I'm looking forward to developing them.
START_CONTENT_5: Before you start using the app, I recommend that you read the tutorial that will explain how it works (accessible via the settings)

MANUAL_BACKUP_INFO_TITLE: Manual backup: what is it for?
MANUAL_BACKUP_INFO_CONTENT_1: It is a last resort solution. To back up your data, first use Settings > Import / Export > Save backup or Share backup.
MANUAL_BACKUP_INFO_CONTENT_2: If these buttons don't work on your phone (no window opens, the file isn't created…), this button generates your backup data as text, without going through the Android files.
MANUAL_BACKUP_INFO_CONTENT_3: Copy this text, then paste it into the online tool ("Click here" link) to get a .json backup file, which you can import back with the Import button.
MANUAL_BACKUP_INFO_CONTENT_4: This text contains all your health data: only share it with people or services you trust.
BACKUP_WHY_MANUAL_CONTENT_1: Your health data is sensitive and belongs to you alone. That's why Life Notes only keeps it on your phone.
BACKUP_WHY_MANUAL_CONTENT_2: For security reasons, I chose to never store your data in the cloud: no server, no account, no data sent over the Internet. Nobody but you can access it, and it can't leak or be sold.
BACKUP_WHY_MANUAL_CONTENT_3: The downside: if you lose, change or reset your phone, or uninstall the app, your data is lost… unless you made a backup.
BACKUP_WHY_MANUAL_CONTENT_4: And the backup can't be automatic: current versions of Android no longer allow an app to save a file to your storage without an action from you. So you have to trigger it yourself.
BACKUP_WHY_MANUAL_CONTENT_5: That's why the app offers backup reminders, weekly or daily, which you can enable in Settings > Customization.
BACKUP_WHY_MANUAL_CONTENT_6: Tip: back up regularly and keep a copy of the file somewhere other than your phone (computer, USB stick, etc.).
ABOUT_DEVELOPER_CONTENT: My name is Seb, I'm a volunteer developer. I created this app so people can have free access, without ads and without data collection, to a tool that could help them track their health.
ABOUT_BACKUP_REMINDER_CONTENT: Don't forget to make regular manual backups of your data via the settings. Backups are not automated.

AUTO_OVERVIEW_HELP_INTRO: The pain overview is the colored dot of each day: it sums up the intensity of a symptom over the day (the one you follow at the top of the screen). It also colors the calendar and the PDF report.
AUTO_OVERVIEW_HELP_INTRO_CLASSIC: The pain overview is the big colored circle on the right of each day: it sums up the intensity of a symptom over the day (the one you follow at the top of the screen). It also colors the calendar and the PDF report.
AUTO_OVERVIEW_HELP_ON_1: It is calculated from your entries of the symptom: the average of their intensities over the day, rounded up to the next half point. It is updated as soon as an entry of the day is added, edited or deleted (until then, past days stay as they are).
AUTO_OVERVIEW_HELP_ON_2: You can still correct it by tapping it, but it will be calculated again at the next entry of this symptom on that day.
AUTO_OVERVIEW_HELP_OFF_1: Nothing is calculated: you have to enter it yourself, day by day, by tapping it and setting the intensity. Until it is entered, the day keeps its default color.
